theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : Real.log ↑(n + 1) ≤ ↑(harmonic n) := by
  cases n
  case zero => norm_num
  case succ k =>
    let ε := Real.eulerMascheroniConstant / 2
    have hε : 0 < ε := by simp [ε]
    have hε' : ε < Real.eulerMascheroniConstant := by simp [ε]
    let h : ∀ n ≥ 4096, ↑(harmonic n) - Real.log (↑n + 1) ≥ ε :=
      by {
        intro n,
        intro hn,
        have : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(harmonic n) - Real.log (↑n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) :=
          Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log_add_one,
        apply (Filter.Tendsto.tendsto_at_top_iff_exists eventually_gt).1,
        intros ε hε,
        rcases hε with (hε : 0 < ε),
        use ε / 2,
        intros n hn,
        have : ↑(harmonic n) - Real.log (↑n + 1) ≥ ε / 2 :=
          (Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log_add_one.tendsto_at_top).eventually_gt ε hε,
        rw [Real.eulerMascheroniConstant],
        exact (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant_pos).trans this,
      }
    have h_n : n ≥ 4096 := Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hn
    have h_ineq : ↑(harmonic n) - Real.log (↑n + 1) ≥ ε := h n h_n
    exact (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant_pos.trans h_ineq).le
